policy: Visible local help. Materials are unordered within the hymn supports; no full model translations or output token sequence occurs here. Supplied elements can support scaffolded production but are not independent recall targets.

supports.text: For this taking action, the bounded phrase on his hand means “into his hand,” with accusative hand. This is a declared composition applying Cook’s qualified directional use of on and the ordinary sense of niman; it is not an attested Old English quotation or a general productive niman-plus-goal rule. A static dative “in his hand” is a defensible alternative construal.
